scope: Reusable explanation hypotheses, not proof of TED-Ed quality or a complete reconstruction

reference.rights_boundary: Reference analysis only. No source frames, medical numbers, characters or publisher branding are included in generated films.

recipes.origin: Engineering hypothesis; not an observed source-video reproduction
use_when: Named places have explicit relative cardinal directions or membership in named regions
do_not_use_when: Distances, surveyed coordinates, complex boundaries or routes must be preserved
The scene must prove actual geography with registered evidence
recipes.implementation_limit: 2-6 fixed places, 0-2 disjoint rectangular regions. North/south/east/west, inside/outside. No geography silhouettes, roads, movement or metric distance.

recipes.origin: Engineering hypothesis; not observed in the cited reference
use_when: One explicitly named entity and metric has two ordered measured snapshots in a shared unit
do_not_use_when: Intermediate values or causality would be invented
recipes.implementation_limit: Two nonnegative numeric snapshots, increases and decreases. Not arbitrary time series, morphing or causal inference.

recipes.origin: Engineering hypothesis; not an observation of the cited reference
use_when: The script gives chronological nonnegative increments in one unit
do_not_use_when: Quantities are invented or use incompatible units
Losses or negative increments require unsupported signed accumulation
recipes.implementation_limit: Two to four increments. No arbitrary time series or negative balances.

recipes.origin: Engineering hypothesis; not an observation of the cited reference
use_when: A procedure has an explicitly stated order
do_not_use_when: A chain would invent a causal claim
recipes.implementation_limit: Two to four linear steps, not a branching workflow or acting rig.

recipes.observed: Existing atlas records heart contraction and traveling vessel-wall response in a split view.
recipes.inferred_principle: Make the cause visible before the receiving object changes; retain both referents long enough to connect them.
use_when: The script establishes a causal mechanism with identifiable cause and affected target
The target has distinct before and after states
do_not_use_when: The script states correlation, uncertainty or a list without causation
The proposed link adds a factual claim absent from script or verified evidence
recipes.implementation_limit: Current runtime uses editable nodes and connecting paths, not pulsating vessel geometry or fluid physics.
test_subjects: A switch closes an electrical circuit

recipes.observed: Existing atlas records persistent vessel geometry with two pressure states and numeric readouts.
recipes.inferred_principle: Preserve the referent and a common measurement scale so the difference, rather than a new picture, carries meaning.
use_when: Two or more verified quantities measure the same property in the same unit
Magnitude difference is the explanation task
do_not_use_when: A categorical distinction is mistaken for a magnitude
recipes.implementation_limit: The current bar comparison is our transfer hypothesis, not a claim that the source used this exact chart.

recipes.observed: Existing atlas records constituents flowing through a vessel before emphasis changes to wall pressure.
recipes.inferred_principle: Keep a recognizable object on a continuous route from origin to destination, then hold the arrival.
use_when: Where something goes is essential to understanding the script
Origin, destination and moving token can be named
do_not_use_when: The explanation requires branching fluid, collisions, retention or deformation unsupported by this renderer
recipes.implementation_limit: Single straight endpoint transfer; no claim of general particle flow, obstacle physics or articulated contact.
